How this hub is built & what still needs a human

What's real vs. pending here

  • Roster group, archetypes, shooter designations, PnR coverage calls, scout notes, Keys to Victory and the Actions & Sets call sheet (kept for the Team Recall questions) are copied from the coaching staff's two completed Melbourne data-collection templates (read 1 Nov 2026). On the Team Overview tab the two Actions & Sets tables are replaced by the Advanced Matchup and Game Plan slides from the Brisbane v Melbourne analysis (3-4 Nov 2026). Recall questions are built only from facts in those templates.
  • Jersey numbers, positions and heights are as given in the Personnel template (heights converted from cm). Goulding is no longer injured and sits in the Rotation group (per Markus, 1 Nov 2026); Wilson has no height listed.
  • Stats Summary: C&S / Off Dribble 3P% from the Opponent Shooting #s sheet (read 3 Nov 2026); other columns from RealGM (2023-24 to 2026-27, all competitions, regular season only). Some RealGM pages could not be read, so Anthony, Ingles and Waardenburg are partial and some cells are blank rather than guessed.
  • Keys to Victory: Trans D, Physical Brutality, Togetherness. Ili and Travers are Drivers (per Markus, 3 Nov 2026).
  • Scout Notes Recall (5 questions below the player cards) is built from the player scout notes and PnR calls; the 12 player questions are unchanged and Team Recall is 5 questions.

Reusing this for the next opponent

Everything on this page is driven by the data arrays at the top of the script - swap in a new opponent's roster and call sheet and the cards, quizzes, print sheet and summary rebuild themselves.
